scope: Working terminology for research and interface use. These are not legal definitions, do not establish equivalent meaning across jurisdictions, and must not be cited as legal authority.
translation_status: Arabic and French labels are candidate drafts. Definitions and context are recorded in English pending professional translation.

definition.text: A legal instrument enacted through a legislature; used here as a research category, not a finding that a particular instrument is in force.

context.text: Classifies records and candidate leads whose instrument is enacted by a legislature.

concepts.provenance: Project research vocabulary drafted for internal consistency; labels are candidate translations and not approved legal terminology.
notes: May include primary and delegated legislation depending on the jurisdiction.

definition.text: A rule made under authority delegated by legislation; the term does not itself establish delegated authority or commencement.

context.text: Classifies delegated instruments and implementing rules.

concepts.provenance: Project research vocabulary drafted for internal consistency; labels are candidate translations and not approved legal terminology.
notes: Delegated authority and commencement must be verified per instrument.

definition.text: A research label for an instrument whose legal effect is recorded as binding after review; it is not inferred from publication alone.

context.text: Describes legal-effect findings, never source discovery status.

concepts.provenance: Project research vocabulary drafted for internal consistency; labels are candidate translations and not approved legal terminology.
notes: Never inferred from a government URL or a successful retrieval.

definition.text: Official explanatory or advisory material that may not create legal obligations; its status is recorded per instrument.

context.text: Distinguishes guidance from legislation and policy in source metadata.

concepts.provenance: Project research vocabulary drafted for internal consistency; labels are candidate translations and not approved legal terminology.
notes: Official guidance may still describe mandatory requirements; verify the instrument itself.

definition.text: An instrument or provision that changes another instrument; the amendment is recorded separately from the consolidated text.

context.text: Describes instrument relationships, not a detected website change.

concepts.provenance: Project research vocabulary drafted for internal consistency; labels are candidate translations and not approved legal terminology.
notes: A changed file is not an amendment until reviewed.

definition.text: The removal of an instrument or provision from legal effect, recorded only where documented.

context.text: Describes an instrument relationship or date; never inferred from a missing page.

concepts.provenance: Project research vocabulary drafted for internal consistency; labels are candidate translations and not approved legal terminology.
notes: A missing source page is not evidence of repeal.

definition.text: The date or condition on which an instrument or provision begins to have legal effect, kept separate from publication and adoption.

context.text: Used for version and date metadata where documented.

concepts.provenance: Project research vocabulary drafted for internal consistency; labels are candidate translations and not approved legal terminology.
notes: Publication, adoption and commencement remain separate dates.

definition.text: The research theme covering access to services, information and environments for people with disabilities; the project does not use it as a compliance rating.

context.text: Groups digital, physical and inclusion records without implying legal obligation.

concepts.provenance: Project research vocabulary drafted for internal consistency; labels are candidate translations and not approved legal terminology.
notes: Not a compliance score and not a legal-effect finding.

definition.text: A policy area covering participation and accommodation of people with disabilities; recorded separately from accessibility standards.

context.text: Used for policy-area classification and candidate metadata.

concepts.provenance: Project research vocabulary drafted for internal consistency; labels are candidate translations and not approved legal terminology.
notes: Terminology differs across jurisdictions and languages.

definition.text: A policy area covering limits on intrusion and control over personal information; it is not synonymous with data protection in every jurisdiction.

context.text: Classifies records and candidate leads on privacy.

concepts.provenance: Project research vocabulary drafted for internal consistency; labels are candidate translations and not approved legal terminology.
notes: Not interchangeable with data protection without checking scope.

definition.text: A policy area covering rules for processing personal data; terminology and scope vary by jurisdiction.

context.text: Used for policy-area and candidate metadata; not a finding of legal effect.

concepts.provenance: Project research vocabulary drafted for internal consistency; labels are candidate translations and not approved legal terminology.
notes: Scope and authority vary by jurisdiction.

definition.text: The process by which public bodies acquire goods and services, including the rules governing tenders, awards and contracts.

context.text: Research theme for future procurement work; no records are published yet.

concepts.provenance: Project research vocabulary drafted for internal consistency; labels are candidate translations and not approved legal terminology.
notes: Future research theme, not an authorized current work package.

definition.text: Software whose licence permits use, study, modification and redistribution under stated conditions; endorsement is not a purchasing mandate.

context.text: Research theme for future work; no records are published yet.

concepts.provenance: Project research vocabulary drafted for internal consistency; labels are candidate translations and not approved legal terminology.
notes: Licence terms and procurement mandates are distinct questions.

definition.text: A contested policy concept concerning control over digital infrastructure, data and technology; it is not reducible to data localisation.

context.text: Research theme for future work; no records are published yet.

concepts.provenance: Project research vocabulary drafted for internal consistency; labels are candidate translations and not approved legal terminology.
notes: A contested term; preserve source-specific usage.

definition.text: A policy area covering environmental impacts and reporting obligations; voluntary standards are not treated as binding law.

context.text: Research theme for future work; no records are published yet.

concepts.provenance: Project research vocabulary drafted for internal consistency; labels are candidate translations and not approved legal terminology.
notes: Voluntary frameworks are not automatically binding.
